Name: Geshur
ModernLocation: Unknown; east of Galilee, toward Syria
Description: A small kingdom east of Galilee, listed among the peoples not driven out, and the home of Talmai, whose daughter Maacah married David and whose son Absalom fled there after killing Amnon.
BiblicalSignificance: Geshur is Absalom's refuge after Amnon's murder, and a kingdom left unconquered.
